reviews.snippet:
I have two bad experiences here:

1. Dr. Rajeev Jain had a problem that my younger brother, who is a dependent on my father, was using the Ayushman card for billing.  As a doctor, he should be prioritizing the diagnosis and cure rather than the billing aspect. Also he is extremely rude.

2. After my C-section delivery here, I was not explained/informed about the medicines mentioned in the discharge summary that I had to continue for the next 5 days after discharge for me and my baby. As a result, I had to suffer in pain as I missed the pain killers and a few more medicines and my baby was without Vitamin D3 drops for 14 days. Thanks to a pediatrician at a different clinic who asked us if we're giving our baby the drops and then we could start it.
